claims.text: The binary classifier used is a Bernoulli Naïve Bayes classifier trained on binary occurrence matrices created from n-grams extracted from publications.
The classifier is trained to determine whether a publication meets specific criteria based on selected sentences from the text.
The classifier performs better when trained on candidate sentences relevant to the criteria rather than randomly selected sentences.
